---
name: Principle change
title: "Principle — "
about: Propose, challenge, supersede, or deprecate a checklist-engineering principle
---

## Proposed change

What principle should be added, changed, superseded, or deprecated?

## Current principle ID

`P-XXX` or `NEW`

## Evidence type

- [ ] SOURCE-ANCHORED
- [ ] PROJECT-SYNTHESIS
- [ ] FIELD-DERIVED
- [ ] HYPOTHESIS

## Evidence

Source, field observation, failure trace, or acceptance-test evidence.

Distinguish source claims from project inference.

## Failure prevented

What specific failure would this principle reduce?

## Behavioral consequence

What observable agent behavior should change if this is promoted?

## Regression case

What case should fail without the principle and pass with it?

## Existing-principle check

Does an ACTIVE principle already cover this behavior? Does this proposal conflict with or supersede one?

## Smallest implementation seam

Which authoritative runtime file would change if the principle is promoted?

## Out of scope

What should explicitly not change?
